prompt: Add `Checkout::pay(&self, cart: &Cart, code: &str, country: &str, card_token: &str)` in src/checkout.rs. It applies the coupon `code` from the checkout's public `coupons: CouponBook` (src/coupons.rs), which must refuse a coupon once its `expires` moment has passed with an error saying it expired; adds VAT for the customer's country (20% for "GB", 19% for "DE", 21% for "NL", none elsewhere; more countries will follow); charges the result in EUR through `StripeClient::create_charge` in src/stripe_client.rs; and returns `Ok` with the charge id. We may add PayPal at some point. `build_checkout(client: Box<dyn StripeClient>) -> Checkout` in src/app.rs must return a ready checkout that charges through `client`.
